_comment: Lighthouse CI configuration (tasks 10.3 + 11.3; seo §9 'Core Web Vitals', §12 'Validation in CI'; ui-ux §12; R9.4, R10.1, R10.4, R10.7). Runs Lighthouse against the PRERENDERED PUBLIC URLs (the same indexable set produced by scripts/prerender.mjs and listed in sitemap.xml), on a mid-range MOBILE profile (Lighthouse's default mobile emulation throttles to a representative mid-tier device + slow 4G), and FAILS THE BUILD on (a) accessibility regressions and (b) Core Web Vitals budget breaches: LCP < 2.5s and CLS < 0.1 (the lab-measurable CWV), plus total-blocking-time as the lab proxy for the field-only INP < 200ms target. INP itself is a FIELD metric no lab tool can measure — it is observed in production via the consent-aware, PII-free `web-vitals` reporting wired in src/utils/webVitals.ts (seo §12). a11y is gated here alongside the axe assertions baked into the vitest component/page suites. IMPORTANT: this automated gate is a FLOOR, not a certificate — see docs/accessibility.md for the manual assistive-technology testing (VoiceOver/TalkBack/NVDA in RTL/Farsi), keyboard-only runs, and expert review that full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance still requires.
